about: Work in progress. Serum 1 presets in two collections: popular PresetShare presets (most liked, across genres and sound types) and the EMP Famous 80s & 90s pack. Each is rendered from its own MIDI part in Serum and, after conversion, in Vital. Same notes, same tempo, no normalization. MIDI cut at 30 s.
